# Packaged deployment tools

`stm32cubeprogrammer_2.23.0_arm64.deb` is the ARM64 STM32CubeProgrammer
package used by native Ubuntu 22.04 onboarding. `tools/onboard_setup.sh`
requires SHA-256
`46b844fd135627290d2d0af3d3897debfa4247ec6af7d1cea3e0e9b0fb0bd31d`
before installing it. The vendor package contains its own license and
copyright material.
